For OND 2023, CCA has lower RMSE than climatology in **31 of 38 provinces**, and PCR in **31 of 38**. For JJA 2023, the corresponding counts are **7** and **7**. In the four-year pooled JJA context, they become **31** and **28**. Those changes show why one year should not be turned into a province-specific forecast recommendation. The smallest province is **Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta**, with **58 pixels**. Pixel counts describe support; neighbouring pixels are not independent samples.
